candidates.change_summary: Replace the balance increase with a decrease so deposits reduce the caller's recorded balance.
Delete the statement crediting the deposited value to the caller's balance.
Credit a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the actual msg.value.
Credit msg.value plus one extra wei to the caller's balance.
Insert a statement zeroing the caller's balance before the credit, so only the latest deposit is recorded.
Change the guard to a strict inequality so the caller can no longer withdraw their entire balance.
Delete the balance decrement so the caller's recorded balance is not reduced after withdrawal.
Set the balance to zero after transfer instead of subtracting only the withdrawn amount.
Subtract only half the amount so a partial withdrawal leaves more balance than in P.
Remove the require(creator == msg.sender) guard so any caller can drain the contract balance via migrateTo.
Transfer only the balance minus 1 wei instead of the entire contract balance, leaving residual funds observable on-chain.
